records.claimText: In the April 2026 Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey, domestic banks reported on balance tighter standards for commercial and industrial loans to firms of all sizes; banks also reported tighter terms including higher premiums on riskier loans, tighter loan covenants, and tighter collateralization requirements for firms of all sizes.
records.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
records.title: The April 2026 Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey on Bank Lending Practices

sourceLocator.value: Lending to Businesses; April 2026 SLOOS summary and Table 1 questions 1-3

authorityDecision.decisionBasis: The Federal Reserve is the primary regulator/publisher of SLOOS. The cited survey directly reports changes in lending standards and contractual terms; admission does not itself establish a Reality Grammar.

boundary: This official gap-evidence batch must be merged into W8D-P2 before semantic derivation. It does not itself promote G2/P3.
